baseline: longest eligible annotated translation; stable unit ID tie-break
budget_scope: five total references per parent or matched query; never five per CDS
expected_families: frozen reviewed documented family sets per parent; full and independently supported denominators reported separately
hypothesis: Representing every eligible documented CDS improves parent family coverage over one longest eligible CDS, without implying better per-unit accuracy.

measurement_policy.timing_scope: cold load separately from inference/pooling/host transfer

merge_rule: max score per reference before deduplication and total top five
source_admission: T02 exact-record gates plus independently reviewed family evidence; selection approval is not source approval
